tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
BDCOM S3900 Switching Family L3 Managed Gigabit/10G Stackable Switch

S3900 Switching family comes with advanced functionality and first-rate performance,6 x 10G uplink ports, and a broad range of downlink options, along with dual hot-swap power supplies.


24-Port Gigabit SFP + 8-Port Gigabit RJ45 + 6-Port 10G SFP+ L3 Stackable Managed Switch

(2 power slots, hot-swap AC-220V power supply, with cooling fan,
1U, 19-inch rack-mounted installation)


Upgrade your enterprise or data center network with the BDCOM S3900-24S8T6X, a high-performance Layer 3 stackable managed switch designed for speed, reliability, and flexibility. This robust switch features 24 Gigabit SFP ports, 8 Gigabit RJ45 ports, and 6 10G SFP+ uplink ports, making it ideal for high-density fiber aggregation and scalable network infrastructure.

Built with advanced L3 routing capabilities, powerful switching capacity, and support for stacking, the S3900-24S8T6X is engineered to deliver seamless performance in modern enterprise, ISP, and campus networks.


Highlight Features:

  • Carrier-Level QoS Policies
  • Varied Service Characteristics
  •  Versatile IPv6 Solution
  • Industrial Ethernet Ring with Zero Delay and Zero Packet Loss
  • Complete Security Mechanism
  • Innovative Energy-Saving Design
  • Flexible and Convenient Management and Maintenance

Key Features:

  • 24× 1G SFP ports for high-speed fiber connections

  • 8× 10/100/1000 Mbps RJ45 ports for flexible copper connectivity

  • 6× 10G SFP+ uplink ports for ultra-fast backbone aggregation

  • Layer 3 routing protocols: Static routing, RIP, OSPF, and more

  • Stacking support for simplified network expansion and management

  • Advanced security: ACLs, DHCP Snooping, ARP Inspection, MAC filtering

  • Rich QoS features for traffic prioritization and optimization

  • Web GUI, CLI, SNMP, and RMON for easy network management

  • Fanless or low-noise design for energy-efficient operation

  • Redundant power support (optional) for high availability


Use Cases:

  • Enterprise Core & Distribution Switch

  • ISP Metro Aggregation Switch

  • Campus Network Backbone

  • Data Center Edge Connectivity


Security & Management:

With rich Layer 2/3 management features and enhanced security controls, the S3900-24S8T6X ensures secure network access and simplified configuration. VLANs, storm control, link aggregation, spanning tree protocols, and port mirroring provide full flexibility for complex environments.
